1.content:
# Camunda 8.7 — Zeebe Cluster & Transport

Ported from the Camunda Grafana dashboard `8.7.35-zeebe.json`. Metrics are expected in Grail as **Micrometer meter names** (`zeebe.stream.processor.records.total`), pushed straight from Camunda over OTLP with `delta` temporality — see `runbook-dynatrace.md`.

**Companion dashboards:** `8.7-zeebe-01-overview.json` · `8.7-zeebe-02-processing.json` · `8.7-zeebe-03-storage.json` · `8.7-zeebe-05-resources.json`

2.content:
## Raft
Raft replication, heartbeats, roles and indices.

3.title: Raft requests per second
3.description: Shows the rate of different raft requests send from the leader to different followers

4.title: Total install requests send
4.description: Shows the total count of send install requests from the leader to the followers

5.title: Leader commit rate
5.description: How many entries are committed per second

6.title: Leader append data rate
6.description: Rate in KiB at which we append data on followers

7.title: Leader append rate
7.description: Rate of entries we append data on followers, counting entries, per partition, per follower

8.title: Snapshot Replication Duration
8.description: Approximate Install RPC as measured by the follower.

9.title: Snapshot Replications
9.description: Ongoing snapshot replications per partition, from the follower point-of-view.

10.title: Append Entry Latency
10.query:
timeseries {
    p50 = percentile(atomix.append.entries.latency, 50),
    p90 = percentile(atomix.append.entries.latency, 90),
    p99 = percentile(atomix.append.entries.latency, 99)
  },
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod)) and in(partition, array($Partition))},
  union: true
10.description: Grafana rendered this as a histogram heatmap; Dynatrace charts the p50/p90/p99 percentiles of the same histogram instead.

11.title: AppendEntry latency

12.title: Time Between Heartbeats
12.query:
timeseries {
    p50 = percentile(atomix.heartbeat.time.in.s, 50),
    p90 = percentile(atomix.heartbeat.time.in.s, 90),
    p99 = percentile(atomix.heartbeat.time.in.s, 99)
  },
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod)) and in(partition, array($Partition))},
  union: true
12.description: Grafana rendered this as a histogram heatmap; Dynatrace charts the p50/p90/p99 percentiles of the same histogram instead.

13.title: Heartbeat Miss Counts
13.query:
timeseries miss_count = sum(atomix.heartbeat.miss.count),
  by: {k8s.pod.name, partition},
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(partition, array($Partition)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod))}
| fieldsAdd miss_count = arrayCumulativeSum(miss_count)
13.description: Counters arrive from Camunda as OTLP **delta** values (Dynatrace does not ingest cumulative counters), so each column is cumulated over the selected timeframe to reproduce Grafana's monotonic counter view.

14.description: Shows when a role change has happened

18.title: Non replicated records
18.query:
timeseries entries = sum(atomix.non_replicated.entries),
  by: {partition, follower},
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod)) and in(partition, array($Partition))}
| fieldsAdd value = arrayLast(entries)
| fields partition, follower, value
18.description: The number of records a follower is lagging behind for a given partition (p) and follower (f)

19.title: Non committed records
19.query:
timeseries entries = sum(atomix.non_committed.entries),
  by: {partition},
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(partition, array($Partition))}
| fieldsAdd value = arrayLast(entries)
| fields partition, value
19.description: The number of locally appended but non committed records on the leader per partition (p)

29.content:
## gRPC
Gateway gRPC server latency and volume.

30.title: Total gRPC requests
30.description:
Shows counts of all gRPC messages, which have been sent to the Zeebe Cluster.

Ported from Grafana: Replaces the `label_replace` + `or on(method, statusCode)` join with the `zeebe.gateway.total.requests` counter (see the note on tile 62).

31.title: gRPC requests per second (range = 1m)
31.query:
timeseries {
    requests_per_sec = sum(zeebe.gateway.total.requests, rate:1s),
    failed_per_sec = sum(zeebe.gateway.failed.requests, rate:1s, default:0)
  },
  by: {requestType},
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod))},
  union: true
31.description: Ported from Grafana: Replaces the `label_replace` + `or on(method, statusCode)` join; adds the failed-request counter so the status dimension of the original panel is still represented.

32.title: Create Process Instance Latency (gRPC)
32.query:
timeseries {

    p90 = percentile(grpc.server.processing.duration, 90, filter:{method == "CreateProcessInstance"}),
    p99 = percentile(grpc.server.processing.duration, 99, filter:{method == "CreateProcessInstance"})
  },
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod))},
  union: true
32.description:

35.content:
## Gateway
Gateway request latency and failure rates.

36.title: Gateway Request Latency
36.query:
timeseries {
    p50 = percentile(zeebe.gateway.request.latency, 50),
    p90 = percentile(zeebe.gateway.request.latency, 90),
    p99 = percentile(zeebe.gateway.request.latency, 99)
  },
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(partition, array($Partition))},
  union: true
36.description:
Shows the latency (RTT) of a sent from the gateway to the broker.

Grafana rendered this as a histogram heatmap; Dynatrace charts the p50/p90/p99 percentiles of the same histogram instead.

37.title: Failure Error Code
37.query:
timeseries {
    failed_requests_a = avg(zeebe.gateway.failed.requests, rate:1s, default:0, filter:{matchesValue(error, "*")}),
    gateway_requests_b = avg(zeebe.gateway.total.requests, rate:1s)
  },
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(partition, array($Partition))},
  union: true,
  nonempty: true
| fieldsAdd ratio = failed_requests_a[] / gateway_requests_b[]
| fieldsRemove failed_requests_a, gateway_requests_b
37.description: Shows rate of each error type.

38.title: Failure Rate by Request Type
38.query:
timeseries {
    failed_requests_a = sum(zeebe.gateway.failed.requests, rate:1s, default:0),
    gateway_requests_b = sum(zeebe.gateway.total.requests, rate:1s)
  },
  by: {requestType},
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(partition, array($Partition))},
  union: true,
  nonempty: true
| fieldsAdd ratio = failed_requests_a[] / gateway_requests_b[]
| fieldsRemove failed_requests_a, gateway_requests_b
38.description: Shows failure rate of requests sent from gateway to the broker.

40.title: Current In-Progress Backups
40.query:
timeseries progress = max(zeebe.backup.operations.in.progress, filter:{operation == "take"}),
  by: {partition},
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(partition, array($Partition)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod))}
| fieldsAdd value = arrayLast(progress)
| fields partition, value

41.title: Completed Backups
41.query:
timeseries backup_operations = max(zeebe.backup.operations.total, filter:{operation == "take" and result == "completed"}),
  by: {partition},
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod))}
| fieldsAdd value = arrayLast(backup_operations)
| fields partition, value

42.title: Status Query Latency
42.query:
timeseries {
    p50 = percentile(zeebe.backup.operations.latency, 50, filter:{operation == "status" and operation == "status"}),
    p90 = percentile(zeebe.backup.operations.latency, 90, filter:{operation == "status" and operation == "status"}),
    p99 = percentile(zeebe.backup.operations.latency, 99, filter:{operation == "status" and operation == "status"})
  },
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod))},
  union: true
42.description: Grafana rendered this as a histogram heatmap; Dynatrace charts the p50/p90/p99 percentiles of the same histogram instead.

43.title: Take Backup Latency
43.query:
timeseries take_latency = avg(zeebe.backup.operations.latency,
    filter: {operation == "take"}),
  by: {partition},
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod)) and in(partition, array($Partition))}
| fieldsAdd avg_seconds = arrayAvg(take_latency)
| fields partition, avg_seconds
| sort avg_seconds desc
43.description: Ported from Grafana: Grafana divided the histogram's `_sum` by its `_count` over a hard-coded 1h window; on this ingest path the histogram carries both, so `avg()` is used and the tile follows the dashboard timeframe instead of a fixed 1h.

44.title: Total Backup Operations
44.query:
timeseries backup_operations = sum(zeebe.backup.operations.total),
  by: {operation, result},
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod))}
| fieldsAdd backup_operations = arrayCumulativeSum(backup_operations)
44.description: Counters arrive from Camunda as OTLP **delta** values (Dynatrace does not ingest cumulative counters), so each column is cumulated over the selected timeframe to reproduce Grafana's monotonic counter view.

45.title: Failed Backups
45.query:
timeseries backup_operations = max(zeebe.backup.operations.total, filter:{operation == "take" and result == "failed"}),
  by: {partition},
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod))}
| fieldsAdd value = arrayLast(backup_operations)
| fields partition, value

50.title: Swim Probe Latency
50.query:
timeseries {
    p50 = percentile(zeebe.messaging.request.response.latency, 50, filter:{in(topic, "atomix-membership-probe-request") and in(topic, "atomix-membership-probe-request")}),
    p90 = percentile(zeebe.messaging.request.response.latency, 90, filter:{in(topic, "atomix-membership-probe-request") and in(topic, "atomix-membership-probe-request")}),
    p99 = percentile(zeebe.messaging.request.response.latency, 99, filter:{in(topic, "atomix-membership-probe-request") and in(topic, "atomix-membership-probe-request")})
  },
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(partition, array($Partition)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod))},
  union: true
50.description:
Shows the execution time of the swim protocol probe.

Grafana rendered this as a histogram heatmap; Dynatrace charts the p50/p90/p99 percentiles of the same histogram instead.

51.title: Swim Protocol Member Incarnation Number
51.description: Members Incarnation number. This metric shows the incarnation number of each member in the several nodes. This is useful for observing the time taken for each member's information propagation.
